title: Real-time Live Camera Auto-Scan OCR Tire Serial Number
description: Mengubah mode kamera agar saat dinyalakan langsung otomatis melakukan continuous scan/capture frame secara berkala (auto extract SN) tanpa perlu menekan tombol foto manual.
completionDetails: Implementasi Real-time Live Camera Auto-Scan OCR Tire Serial Number dengan continuous frame loop, audio & visual feedback, deteksi duplikat, dan toggle Auto-Scan ON/OFF.
